comment: Read from src/ModMatrix.cpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1, alongside the README. The twelve signal inputs and the sixteen Mix outputs carry whatever is patched into them, so they are given no family; only the two knob-value outputs are certain to be control voltages. The Control knob base values input is read one channel per column (ModMatrix.cpp:592), so a sixteen-channel cable sets a different range for each column, and an unconnected jack stands in as 5V in bipolar mode or 10V in unipolar; the jack's own name changes between those two readings (ModMatrix.cpp:367 and 371). A Mix output that has no cable is skipped entirely (ModMatrix.cpp:587). The browser's description calls the matrix 13x16, counting the base-values jack among the inputs; the matrix itself is twelve signals by sixteen mixes.
